### `economic` · `doublet` → `DoubletEconomicComponent`

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `component_idx` | `int` | required | Circuit index. 0 is the circuit entry (injection well, solved first). The BC checkpoint (surface) is identified separately via `bc_checkpoint_idx` in `sim_config`. |
| `save_interval` | `int \| None` | `1` | Timestep interval at which `record()` appends state to history. `None` disables history recording entirely. Default `1` records every timestep (matches the original `record_history=True` behavior). |
| `project_maturity` | `ProjectMaturity` | required | Whether wells/permitting/exploration already exist (BROWN_FIELD) or must still be paid for (GREEN_FIELD). |
| `discount_rate` | `float` | required | Discount rate as a dimensionless fraction (e.g. 0.095 = 9.5%). |
| `main_product` | `MainProduct` | `<MainProduct.ELECTRICITY: 'electricity'>` | Which output is the plant's primary product — determines LCOE vs LCOH. |
| `capacity_factor` | `float` | `0.9` | Plant capacity factor (dimensionless fraction). |
| `opex_cost_fraction` | `float` | `0.045` | Base O&M cost as a fraction of CAPEX, before by-product revenue offset. |
| `electricity_price` | `float` | `0.25` | By-product electricity price ($/kWh) — used only when main_product is HEAT. |
| `heat_price` | `float` | `0.05` | By-product heat price ($/kWh) — used only when main_product is ELECTRICITY. |
| `gengeo_quadratic_length_coeff` | `float` | `0.105` | `_well_section_cost`'s `L^2` coefficient — economies-of-scale term on a well section's own combined depth. GenGEO's default cost basis; override from YAML if a different cost basis is needed. |
| `gengeo_diameter_length_coeff` | `float` | `1776.0` | `_well_section_cost`'s `d*L` coefficient (diameter- and length-dependent casing/material cost). GenGEO's default cost basis. |
| `gengeo_mobilization_cost_usd` | `float` | `275300.0` | `_well_section_cost`'s fixed mobilization cost, charged once per well SECTION (see `_compute_well_capex`'s docstring for what counts as one section). GenGEO's default cost basis. |
